text: 投机资金离场，央行买盘托底，金价能否稳住4200美元 长端利率继续走高，金价并未跌破前低，黄金对利率利空的敏感度正在下降。
text_en: Speculative funds exit, central bank buying supports, can gold prices stabilize at $4,200? Long-end rates continue to rise, gold prices have not fallen below previous lows, and gold's sensitivity to bearish interest rate factors is declining.
